ops.title: spawnllm v0.4.0 (RunSpec/run/MLX backend) is released to PyPI and all ~/Code consumers are migrated + pushed; only ccxbench wiring still pending
ops.body:
spawnllm v0.4.0 (2026-06-22) replaced the old per-backend `build_command(model, schema_path, agent)` + `ClaudeCliBackend.cc_sentiment`/`build_argv` hack with a first-class, spec-driven, async-first contract:
- `RunSpec` (common fields) + `provider_configs: dict[ProviderName, ClaudeConfig|CodexConfig|GeminiConfig]`; literal model passthrough (no tier map in `run`).
- Backend contract is now `LlmBackend.aexecute/execute(spec) -> RunResult`; CLI backends share a `CliBackend` mid-class (`build_command(spec)` + `invocation(spec)`); `MlxBackend` is an in-process **opt-in** backend (never auto-selected; not in `PRIORITY`).
- Entry points: async-first `run`/`run_sync` (raw `RunResult`, envelope-aware 529 retry built in) and `call`/`call_sync` (parsed). The old sync top-level `call()` is gone.
- **Removed (breaking):** `ClaudeCliBackend.cc_sentiment`, `.build_argv`, `.inline_system_prompt`, `.verbose`, static `parse_result_envelope` (module-level `parse_result_envelope` kept).

**Why:** the `ccxbench` cost harness needed full Claude flag passthrough + raw output + retry; the user chose to de-hack properly rather than band-aid, with no backwards-compat.

**How to apply:**
- **spawnllm 0.4.0 is released** — tag `v0.4.0` (commit `e2a3f8e`) on `yasyf/spawnllm` triggered the PyPI trusted-publish + GitHub release; installable as `spawnllm==0.4.0` (extras `adapter`/`mlx`).
- All five consumers (cc-pushback, cc-sentiment, captain-hook, cc-transcript, semisweet) are migrated, green, and **committed + pushed to `main`** ("refactor: migrate to spawnllm 0.4.0 (RunSpec/run API)"); each now depends on the **published** `spawnllm>=0.4.0` (local `[tool.uv.sources]` path dep removed). cc-sentiment's MLX classifier still uses `spawnllm.mlx.MlxEngine` directly (only its Claude path moved to `RunSpec`+`ClaudeConfig`).
- Gotchas seen: `uv` cached the old PyPI index — needs `uv sync --refresh-package spawnllm` right after a publish. jj 0.42 has no `describe --reset-author`; a commit with an empty committer is re-stamped by a no-op rewrite (temp message → back) once `jj config set --user user.name/email` is set. cc-sentiment `main` prints a "protected ref" notice but the owner push still lands.
- **Pending (not done):** the originating consumer **ccxbench (Part C in `~/Code/cc-context/bench`) is not yet wired** to `run_sync(RunSpec)` — that is the downstream task that motivated this work.
- **Update 2026-07-18:** spawnllm 0.8.0 shipped as the first **lockstep three-language release** — Go bindings (`github.com/yasyf/spawnllm/go`, wazero-embedded WASM core) and Rust crates (`spawnllm` + `spawnllm-core` on crates.io, trusted publishing via `release-crates.yml` env `crates-io`) release from the same `v*` tag as PyPI; a `go/vX.Y.Z` alias tag is auto-minted. Committed versions stay `0.0.0` sentinels; fix forward, never retag. See [[crates-io-trusted-publishing-api]].
- See [[verify-tool-cli-surfaces-live]] before touching CLI flags; backend argv shapes have golden tests in `tests/test_backends.py`.
